name: Rusty Spire Cleaver
description: A jagged piece of rusty iron, scarred by countless executions.

name: Dusk Dagger
description: Blackened blade dipped in nightshade. Strikes with blinding quickness.

name: Headsman's Crescent
description: Heavy dark-steel blade that yearns for vertebrae.

name: Bone-Crusher Flanged Mace
description: Dense spiked bludgeon designed to splinter knightly gothic plate.

name: Runic Bastard Greatsword
description: Ancient broadsword etched with glowing glyphs of the fallen paladins.

name: Shadow Piercer Nodachi
description: Folded obsidian blade that cuts through reality itself.

name: Harvester of the Damned
description: Pulses with the stolen heartbeats of fallen climbers.

name: Soul Devourer Blade
description: Whispers madness into the wielder. Enormous lethality at the price of flesh.

name: Wanderer's Padded Brigandine
description: Stiff leather vest layered with iron rings, smelling of peat smoke.

name: Carapace of the Unburied
description: Ribcages of ancient foes stitched with rusted wire.

name: Black Guard Cuirass
description: Fluted dark-steel armor forged to withstand siege trebuchets.

name: Shroud of the Void Stalker
description: Dark cloth woven from shadows that swallows incoming strikes.

name: Abyssal Juggernaut Plate
description: Forged in the underworld bowels beneath the Spire. Unbreakable.

name: Garb of the Crimson Martyr
description: Constantly weeps fresh blood. Grants terrifying regenerative hunger.

name: Spire Sentry Helm
description: Narrow slit visor with dried blood along the rim.

name: Crypt Stalker Hood
description: Supple shadow-leather cowl that muffles footsteps.

name: Valkyrie Winged Bascinet
description: Adorned with tarnished silver wings that channel celestial fury.

name: Cowl of the Faceless
description: Obscures the wearer's face in eternal twilight.

name: Martyr's Jagged Crown
description: Pierces the wearer's skull, granting terrifying lethality at great agony.

name: Crown of the Ascended Monarch
description: Radiates sovereign dominion over the damned citadel.

name: Reinforced Oak Buckler
description: Oak planks bound with iron rivets to parry incoming blades.

name: Spiked Iron Targe
description: Fitted with a vicious 8-inch central spike to counter-strike foes.

name: Buckler of the Weeping Mother
description: Embossed with a sorrowful face that deflects heavy impacts.

name: Grimoire of the Blood Moon
description: Bound in ghoul skin, chanting incantations that leach enemy vitality.

name: Aegis of the Sunken Fortress
description: Tower shield blessed by titans, capable of repelling falling meteors.

name: Totem of the Flayed Prophet
description: Cackling shrunken skull that hungers for mortal combat.

name: Climber's Copper Band
description: Simple etched ring worn by ancient wanderers for good fortune.

name: Signet of the Shadow Guild
description: Engraved with raven feathers, hastening reflexes.

name: Nocturnal Fang Amulet
description: Preserved canine of an elder bat vampire, thirsty for gore.

name: Gargoyle Eye Talisman
description: Carved from the ocular stone of the Floor 10 sentinel.

name: Heart of the Nether Citadels
description: Pulsing core of solidified dark ether, empowering all attributes.

name: Band of the Cursed Execution
description: Gives fatal precision on critical strikes, sacrificing mortal endurance.
